---
title: "About"
---

I am an Associate Professor of Biostatistics at Vanderbilt University Medical Center. My work centers on collaborative research in pediatrics, gastroenterology, neonatology, and infectious disease, with methodological interests in longitudinal data analysis and Bayesian latent variable models.

See the [Home page](index.qmd) for my education, work experience, and short bio, and the [Teaching](teaching/index.qmd), [Projects](projects/index.qmd), and [Publications](publications/index.qmd) pages for more.

#### About this site

This site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and hosted on GitHub Pages. Quarto lets me write pages in Markdown and embed R code and output directly, which supports the reproducible, transparent workflows I value in my research.

The source is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/chrissl789/chrissl789.github.io).
